note: vid-ending is the last per-video script step. Its inputs are a body-complete script.md with a non-stub ## Intro plus piece.md (format, goal, pillar), the shared foundation (creator-foundation Top 3 problems drive the Gap), and a channel catalog of already-published videos the Bridge can point at. No after-segment stage exists in tests/fixtures/stages yet (vid-structure/vid-intro/vid-segment suites are not built), so the suite freezes its own upstream states under fixtures/upstream/{slug}/ (piece.md + body-complete script.md, hand-authored to the vid-ending SKILL.md prerequisites) and a published-video catalog under fixtures/catalog/content/pieces/{slug}/piece.md. The test runner drives vid-ending once per case with the creator-simulator playing Sam Rivera, starting from the upstream fixture, and writes outputs/case_NN/ containing script.md (with the filled ## Ending block) and piece.md (ending_locked, next_video). transcript.md is optional and never scored for fabrication or brand rules because it legitimately echoes the creator's own words.
